archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Grid Borders (Botanical Brutalism)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical/Notebook' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts for dashboard panels. Use 1px sharp borders (`border-[#D1CCC2]`). No soft drop shadows. For active elements, use a solid 2px offset shadow (`shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#1C201F]`) to give a tactile, analog notebook feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle paper grain texture to the main app wrapper using the provided image (mix-blend-multiply, low opacity) to reduce digital eye strain and enhance the organic feel.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use extremely subtle radius (`rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`) to emulate physical paper and folders. Avoid heavy pills unless for main CTAs.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or slightly rounded (`rounded-sm`). Primary CTAs (e.g., 'Record Lecture') should be Terracotta with an Ink border. Use `hover:-translate-y-[1px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#1C201F] transition-all`.
components.cards: Cardless design or sharp 1px border panels with generous padding (`p-6` or `p-8`). Background should be the paper color.
components.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for desktop. High contrast vertical borders separating the sidebar from the main content. Include sections for: 'Library', 'Record', and 'Tests'.
components.tables_and_lists: Use minimal borders on list items. Strip default soft shadows from tables. Align text left.
components.transcription_view: Large, readable typography for transcripts (Manrope `text-lg`). Generous line height.
components.test_quiz_interface: Tightly packed bento grid for questions, or one question per view with bold, clear typography. Correct answers highlighted in Sage, incorrect in Terracotta.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid). 1px grid borders separating widgets. Main Content area should utilize a split layout for studying: Transcript (left) and AI Summary (right) side-by-side.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use `gap-6` or `gap-8`, and padding `p-8` to give breathing room for dense reading material.

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle translation on buttons. Instant, snappy transitions for data tabs.
motion_and_interactions.recording_state: When recording, display a pulsing Terracotta indicator (`animate-pulse`) and visualize audio activity if possible.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for subtle fade-ins and Y-axis slides (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}`) when switching between dashboard views.

media_and_assets.icons: Use `lucide-react` with stroke-width 1.5 for a delicate, crisp appearance.

images.description: Delicate green leaves on a white background
images.category: Empty States (Use when the lecture library is empty or a user needs to select a lecture)
Background Texture (Overlay on the main background, opacity ~10%, pointer-events-none, mix-blend-multiply)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the paper background meets APCA standards. Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a high-contrast focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ink focus:outline-none`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="start-recording-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JS files (.js, .jsx), NOT TypeScript.
Do NOT add `text-align: center` to the app container. Maintain left alignment for readability.
Implement Web Speech API in a dedicated hook/utility for the recording feature.

Implement a mock for Deepseek API calls (summarization and test generation) using `setTimeout` to simulate async backend processing. HIGHLIGHT in comments or toast notifications that AI responses are MOCKED.
Load `Cormorant Garamond`, `Manrope`, and `JetBrains Mono` fonts from Google Fonts in the index.html or global CSS.
Use Tailwind configuration to add the custom colors provided in the guidelines.
Build the UI focusing on a dual-pane layout for the lecture details page: Transcript on one side, AI Notes on the other.
Follow the 'Grid Borders' surface strategy: exposed skeleton, 1px borders between main sections.
Use Shadcn UI components where applicable, but override their styles to match these guidelines.

universal_guidelines.creativity: Avoid generic SaaS 'slop'. Embrace the 'Botanical Brutalism' aesthetic—a mix of structured grid borders with warm, organic typography and colors.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Generous padding makes reading text-heavy apps much easier.
universal_guidelines.components: Reuse existing shadcn components from `src/components/ui` but remove soft drop shadows. Replace them with sharp 1px borders and solid offset shadows for interactive states.
